prompt: Using the first input ONLY as painting style, create a new isolated botanical single-plant game-asset reference of one very young tatsoi seedling (乌塌菜, Brassica rapa var. rosularis/narinosa), just developing its first true leaves. Inputs 2 and 3 are real botanical morphology references only, not texture to copy. Two small opposite round kidney/heart-shaped cotyledons with shallow tip notches, plus two unequal emerging round-spoon true leaves, one slightly larger and gently cupped with visible branching fine veins, the other a small folded center leaf. Slender short light-green stems join at one tiny basal crown. Four leaves only, much simpler than a juvenile rosette. Not a scaled mature cabbage, no broad fleshy white bok choy stalks. Handpainted Chinese gongbi: crisp fine moss-green structural vein lines and selective fine outline, restrained layered jade/sage pigment washes with subtle darker ink mottling; botanical volume, not photographic lighting or glossy plastic. Fresh green leaves, no yellow antique filter. Three-quarter view 30 degrees from above showing front/back depth and every attachment; full plant centered with 15% breathing margin. Isolated against flat pale neutral gray, no soil, roots, pot, tray, pedestal, cast shadow, writing, watermark, collage or other objects. Root base is lowest point; all leaf blades intact, no holes or insect bites.
review: Initial painting retained for provenance; leaf morphology suitable, composition too planar/fan-like for reliable 3D volume; not submitted to Tripo.
